mapper.select: SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ t.TRADE_DATE redConfirmDate,/**确认日期**/ t.TRADE_AMT redConfirmAmt,/**确认金额**/ t.SHARE_AMT redConfirmNum,/**确认数量**/ t.UNIT_CPRICE redUnitValue,/**单位净值**/ t.FEE_AMT redFee,/**赎回费**/ null arriveDate,/**到账日期**/ null tradeAmtArrive,/**到账金额**/ nvl(t.MY_ACCT_NO,stl.MY_ACCT_NO) redMyAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE in(#{busiType_06},#{busiType_07}) AND STL.ORDER_TYPE NOT LIKE 'N%' LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE in (#{busiType_06},#{busiType_07}) and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1

SELECT t.TRADE_ID tradeId,/**交易编号**/ t.F_TRADE_ID outTradeId, /*外部成交编号*/ NVL(deal1.BOOKSET_ID,deal2.BOOKSET_ID) prodId,/**金融产品代码**/ bok.BOOKSET_NAME prodName,/**金融产品名称**/ zc.FINPROD_ID assetId, /**资产代码**/ zc.FINPROD_ABBR assetAbbr,/**资产简称**/ t.PS ps,/**交易方向**/ t.TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket,/**交易场所**/ t.CCY ccy,/**币种**/ tpd.TRADE_DATE redConfirmDate,/**确认日期**/ tpd.TRADE_AMT redConfirmAmt,/**确认金额**/ tpd.SHARE_AMT redConfirmNum,/**确认数量**/ tpd.UNIT_CPRICE redUnitValue,/**单位净值**/ tpd.FEE_AMT redFee,/**赎回费**/ t.TRADE_DATE arriveDate,/**到账日期**/ t.TRADE_AMT tradeAmtArrive,/**到账金额**/ nvl(t.MY_ACCT_NO,stl.MY_ACCT_NO) redMyAcctNo/**资金账户**/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL t LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd ON t.F_TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT zc on zc.finprod_id = t.finprod_id LEFT JOIN STL_ORDERS stl ON stl.TRADE_ID = t.TRADE_ID AND stl.BUSI_TYPE in(#{busiType_06},#{busiType_07}) AND STL.ORDER_TYPE NOT LIKE 'N%' LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal1 on deal1.BUSI_NO = t.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_DEAL_ACCOUNTING deal2 ON stl.ORDER_ID = deal2.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET bok on (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal1.BOOKSET_ID) OR (bok.BOOKSET_ID = deal2.BOOKSET_ID) where t.BUSI_TYPE in (#{busiType_06},#{busiType_07}) and t.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and rownum=1
